shared_elements: motifs stacked vertically down the surface
comb-like or toothed row of short parallel strokes
justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic, linear, curvilinear anthropomorphic imagery combined with round disc/ring motifs and rows of short parallel strokes, and in both the motifs stack vertically down a tall field. However, A is a scattered panel of independent, loosely spaced outline figures with no single organising body, whereas B is one unified frontal humanoid whose motifs are arranged as attributes on head, chest and waist, so the relationships between elements are quite different.
